headline: Apple releases iOS 27.2 with new Siri AI features and other updates
summary: Apple shipped iOS and macOS 27.2. The update adds Siri AI features, including new languages and the ability to limit which apps Siri can access, plus Apple Pencil support and an Edge Light feature for the iPhone Duo, dual camera support for FaceTime, two new CarPlay features, and security fixes.
